name: Isosteareth-2
description: Isosteareth-2 (CAS 52292-17-8 ) is a low-ethoxylate nonionic surfactant derived from isostearyl alcohol. It functions primarily as an emulsifier and wetting agent across personal care, cleaning, and industrial formulations. In cosmetic formulations, it stabilizes water-in-oil and oil-in-water emulsions in creams, lotions, and conditioning products where a low HLB emulsifier is required. This versatility makes it a staple for many manufacturers. Home care and industrial cleaning formulators use it to improve substrate wetting and soil dispersion in hard surface cleaners and degreasers. It provides excellent performance in removing tough residues from various surfaces. Textile processing operations apply it as a wetting and softening agent during fiber treatment and finishing steps. This ensures that fabrics maintain a high-quality feel and consistent texture throughout the production cycle. In leather processing, it supports uniform penetration of treatment liquids into hides, improving consistency across production batches. This leads to a more reliable end product for high-end leather goods manufacturing. Isosteareth-2 is typically supplied as a liquid or low-viscosity paste, depending on temperature and formulation grade. Technical and cosmetic grades are available to meet specific industry requirements and standards. Cosmetic-grade material meets purity requirements suited for leave-on and rinse-off personal care products.
